label: November 2–8, 2026
intro: Quiet week after Halloween: a good time for skating sessions and the Marvel Experience, with Bangkok Art Biennale opening.
weekday_note: Weekday skating or the Roller Dome is the best bet while event listings are still thin.

activities.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 (reported start Oct 29)
activities.date: From Thursday October 29 to Feb 28, 2027 (one source; unconfirmed)
activities.location: BACC, Wat Pho and other venues
activities.why: Large-scale art installations to wander through. Pick one or two sites.
activities.tip: Dates from a single source; confirm before going.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — rollerblading & lessons
activities.why: Rollerblading is on Thor's list; instructors and free borrowed safety gear make it beginner-friendly.
activities.tip: Go early, it gets hot; some instructors speak limited English.

activities.title: Sub Zero Ice Skate Club — daytime sessions
activities.location: Sub Zero, Ekkamai / Major Cineplex Sukhumvit
activities.price: About 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults (weekday, per one guide)
activities.why: Cheap weekday ice skating, quiet before the evening club crowd.
activities.tip: Evenings turn into a nightclub, so stick to daytime. Confirm prices.

activities.title: The Rink at CentralWorld — kids' beginner lessons
activities.price: About 260 THB for a 90-minute session incl. skates (older guide)
activities.why: Smaller rink with 'practice penguins' to help young beginners balance.
activities.tip: Prices from an undated guide; check before going.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.why: Two-hour campaign with Iron Man and a Stark Mobile Lab zone: top pick for an Iron Man fan.
activities.tip: Information is older; confirm it is still open and the ticket price first.

activities.title: Thai Toys exhibition — Children's Discovery Museum
activities.date: Any day (year-long from March 2026, unconfirmed end date)
activities.why: Hands-on science through traditional toys, a good building-and-making fit.
activities.tip: End date is inferred, so check the museum page.
